DEEP-DIVE

UNICREDIT SOCIAL STRATEGY

THE CONTEXT: THE SOCIAL CHALLENGES

OUR ROLE: EMPOWERING COMMUNITIES TO PROGRESS

We are aware that our countries face different social challenges, with their social priorities reflected in EU programmes. EU social taxonomy represents a first attempt to define a full framework which we may take into account to build our social offer

Empowering communities to progress entails the enhancement of our approach to social factors by leveraging the solid position and strong synergies already built with Social Impact Banking and UnCredit Foundation.
